name: fresh-mnist-inception-fid-v2
role: Secondary image-quality analysis of all six fixed-budget campaign generators, planned before inspecting these FID values; no model or seed selection from FID
real_selection: first 5000 canonical MNIST test images in archive order
fake_selection: first 5000 of each campaign's 10000 balanced class-conditioned samples
feature: Torch-Fidelity Inception-v3 2048 pretrained features via TorchMetrics FrechetInceptionDistance
preprocessing: grayscale repeated to RGB; real uint8/255, fake clamp(-1,1)/2+0.5; TorchMetrics normalize=True uint8 conversion and internal resize
compute: MPS float32 convolutions with explicitly enabled CPU fallback for unsupported antialiased resize; float64 accumulated moments and FID computation on CPU; cached real moments reused identically
technical_amendment: CPU-only extraction was superseded after throughput qualification and before any FID scores were produced. Eight real-image feature vectors must match CPU within declared tolerance before GPU scoring starts.
limits: This is a new protocol, not a reproduction of archived FID or T4 latency. Inception features were developed for natural RGB images and have limitations for MNIST. Finite-sample FID is biased and three seeds support descriptive comparisons only. Generator training budgets/devices differ, so this is not a compute-matched efficiency result.
